verdict.rationale: Supermemory has a published pricing page that bills per ingested token: only unique content is billed and repeats are free (docs-13). Named plan tiers exist ('Max plan and above', docs-50), and the superrag task type is described as '5x cheaper per token' (docs-53), which confirms a per-unit billing model. The evidence does not show a free tier or concrete per-unit dollar rates, so a platform engineer could not yet project costs from what is shown. Missing for 10: an explicit free tier, actual per-token or per-unit prices, plan price points or limits, and independent corroboration of the pricing.
